metadata.title: Black Hole Mergers Induced by Tidal Encounters with a Galactic Centre Black Hole

notes: No eligible stars: the paper refers only generically to hypervelocity stars (T:p1-b11) and hyper-velocity BHs (T:p9-b3), without identifying any individual star or retaining any star as a Galactic unbound candidate. GW151226 (T:p7-b5) is mentioned only as a black-hole merger event and is not an eligible star.
